# Fixture provenance and independence
`v1/cases.json`:112 scalar behavior vectors. Every case is explicitly synthetic or real_reference and states its oracle. Synthetic coordinates/lighting/weather are test constructions, NOT historical rocket observations. `v1/schema-examples.json` contains positive/negative synthetic model examples; passing them proves schema constraints only. `tests/acceptance/scenarios.json` defines real-component acceptance scenarios, whose test inputs may be synthetic. Their execution requires the future application.

`raw/` holds actual downloaded bytes. `spec/research/retrievals.json` has source URL, retrieval UTC, HTTP status, SHA256 and byte count; each repository URL is pinned to its downloaded tree commit. Failed404 response retained as retrieval evidence, not ingested data. Real fixture provenance: Census21201/00601 rows; USNO solar events at21201; Orbcomm OG2 analyzed data/events from Unlicense archive; LL2 and NWS provider snapshots. Retain original source licenses in raw files. Research copies of third-party source are NOT linked into production; NOTAM parser has license conflict. Root LL2 schema license metadata does not automatically cover linked imagery.

Reference independence:
- PROJ topocentric pipeline via pyproj3.7.2 derives ENU/bearing/elevation/range, independent of future Skyfield/application implementation. Approximate Cape/near-pad target coordinates are SYNTHETIC fixtures; a high target east of Maryland does not assert a flown route.
- USNO one-day API supplies2026-10-13 sunrise07:14/set18:30 at21201 with explicit UTC-04; input dst=false avoids adding DST twice. Returned local minutes convert to UTC11:14/22:30 with120s acceptance tolerance under same solar convention.
- Census row values read directly from pinned archive, not application ZIP resolver. Orbcomm scalar expectations read raw arrays and multiply km by1000, not reconstructed route output.
- DST references use IANA/zoneinfo; PRD hand-specified slip and decision/threshold tables supply rule outcomes. Analytic Earth shadow cases use rays along+x and ellipsoid geometry; no Skyfield output used as oracle.

`tools/derive_references.py` regenerates independently; NEVER run it to make an implementation failure disappear. Oracle changes require source/rule review, new fixture version when semantics change, and hash update in reference-manifest.json. Application cannot import reference generator. A held-out real mission is not yet admitted: record G-REAL blocked until T02 sources route, datum/stage compatibility and independent case. Real archive parser fixture alone cannot pass that gate. Real observations and official-guidance classification are separate evidence paths.
